commands.label: World Morph / Transformation
commands.desc: Environment transforms into a brand-relevant form while product stays accurate.
commands.instruction: Morph architecture, terrain or supporting objects into a brand-relevant visual state while keeping the exact product unchanged and the transformation physically readable.

commands.label: Puzzle Assembly
commands.desc: Large pieces assemble into a product, logo or campaign structure.
commands.instruction: Stage a frozen key moment where rigid puzzle-like pieces are assembling into a recognizable brand/product-related form with believable joints, spacing and shadows.

commands.label: Domino Chain Reaction
commands.desc: Sequential rigid objects create a dramatic branded chain reaction.
commands.instruction: Create one static hero moment of a domino-like chain reaction using brand-relevant objects. Maintain clear cause/effect, collisions and readable product focus.

commands.label: Rigid-Body Cascade
commands.desc: Objects collide, tumble or cascade around the product.
commands.instruction: Stage a controlled rigid-body cascade around the exact product with believable gravity, collision spacing and contact. Avoid random clutter.

commands.label: Mechanical Choreography
commands.desc: Custom machine presents or interacts with the product.
commands.instruction: Design a believable kinetic machine—arms, rollers, belts, gears, rings or tracks—that stages the exact product in one strong frozen campaign moment.

commands.label: Facade Bloom
commands.desc: Flowers, forms or brand elements bloom outward from architecture.
commands.instruction: Create a controlled architectural bloom where supplied brand-relevant organic or sculptural elements emerge from a facade with realistic attachment, scale and shadow.

commands.label: Zipper / Unzip Reveal
commands.desc: Surface unzips or parts to reveal product or world.
commands.instruction: Use a giant zipper, seam or split-surface mechanism to open a facade, billboard, package-like wall or environment and reveal the exact product.

commands.label: Peel-Back Reveal
commands.desc: Poster, wall skin or surface peels back to expose a second layer.
commands.instruction: Create a believable peel-back campaign using paper, vinyl, wall skin or flexible surface with realistic thickness, curl, tension and shadows.

commands.label: Escalator Interaction
commands.desc: Product rides, emerges from or interacts with an escalator.
commands.instruction: Use a realistic escalator as a spatial mechanism for the exact product or brand element. Maintain step geometry, perspective, support and human scale.

commands.label: Elevator Reveal
commands.desc: Elevator doors open to an oversized product or alternate world.
commands.instruction: Create one static reveal moment using realistic elevator doors, lift shaft or platform mechanics opening onto the exact product or brand-relevant world.

commands.label: Falling Objects
commands.desc: Products or brand elements freeze mid-fall in a controlled composition.
commands.instruction: Capture a physically believable frozen moment of falling exact products or brand elements with gravity, spacing, motion cues and shadows.

commands.label: Floating / Flying Objects
commands.desc: Airborne product or elements move through a believable world.
commands.instruction: Create a controlled flying/floating scene using altitude, wind, perspective and atmospheric depth. Avoid unsupported random levitation.

commands.label: Parachute Drop
commands.desc: Products descend into a city, event or landscape.
commands.instruction: Capture products or branded packages descending under believable parachutes with correct canopy inflation, cords, wind and scale.

commands.label: Blimp / Flying Product
commands.desc: Product becomes a giant airborne spectacle.
commands.instruction: Create a giant product/blimp-style spectacle with believable volume, altitude, atmospheric perspective and flight/mooring logic.

commands.label: Hot-Air Balloon Product
commands.desc: Product or brand form becomes a balloon spectacle.
commands.instruction: Create a hot-air-balloon concept derived from product/brand shape with believable envelope material, basket/tethers and altitude scale.

commands.label: Swarm Formation
commands.desc: Particles or repeated objects assemble into a recognizable form.
commands.instruction: Use a controlled swarm of brand-relevant particles or repeated objects to form, surround or reveal the product with purposeful density and direction.

commands.label: Product Trail
commands.desc: Repeated product or elements create a directional visual path.
commands.instruction: Create a trail, arc or procession of repeated exact products/brand elements that guides the eye through depth while avoiding clutter and false quantity claims.

commands.label: Orbit / Ring System
commands.desc: Rings or orbital structures create kinetic depth around product.
commands.instruction: Build a sculptural ring/orbit system around the exact product with believable supports, intersections, depth and frozen motion.

commands.label: Cut-Through Architecture
commands.desc: Product appears to cut through walls, floors or structures.
commands.instruction: Create a believable static impact where the exact product passes through or interrupts architecture without damaging or deforming the product itself. Show correct cut edges and shadows.

commands.label: Theme-Park Mechanism
commands.desc: Ride, track or amusement system becomes a product-story device.
commands.instruction: Use a rollercoaster, ferris wheel, ride, track or amusement mechanism as a brand-relevant metaphor around the exact product. Keep structure and scale coherent.
